gameDescription:
Guide the ninja through the shadows.
Avoid light at all costs.
Rescue the princess... if you can.
instructions: Use arrow keys, WASD, or tap to move.
princessDetected: The princess has detected the ninja! The entire palace is lit up!
caughtInLight: You were caught in the light!
ninjaFailed: Unfortunately, in this life, the ninja cannot rescue the princess.
